goal.title: Automated Codebase Audit & CI Verification
goal.description: Autonomous repository inspection, security vulnerability scan, lint check, and GitHub Actions workflow hardening.
constraints: Never commit or push directly to main branch
Require user approval before creating Pull Request or writing disk changes
Every task must pass independent verification (PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED)

tasks.title: Inspect Repository Structure & Package Manifest
tasks.description: Analyze repository files, identify package manager, scripts, and build targets.

verification.expected: Valid package.json with detected build and test scripts
verification.evidence: Found package.json: Name "react-example", Scripts: [dev, build, start, preview, clean, lint]. Framework: React + Vite + Tailwind + Express.

tasks.resultSummary: Found package.json: Name "react-example", Scripts: [dev, build, start, preview, clean, lint]. Framework: React + Vite + Tailwind + Express.

tasks.title: Security & Vulnerability Audit
tasks.description: Audit dependencies for known CVEs, hardcoded credentials, and unsafe scripts.

verification.expected: Zero unapproved high/critical severity security issues

tasks.title: TypeScript Typecheck & Linter Verification
tasks.description: Run static analysis to verify code soundness without runtime crashes.

verification.expected: Exit code 0 from TypeScript compilation check

tasks.title: Generate GitHub Actions CI/CD Pipeline Spec
tasks.description: Draft a zero-cost GitHub Actions workflow file for automated tests on pull requests.

verification.expected: Valid YAML workflow schema using free GitHub Actions quota

tasks.title: Create Verified Pull Request Spec
tasks.description: Compile verified test evidence, security summary, and open non-destructive PR.

verification.expected: PR documentation with PASS verification evidence attached
